fact: Africa50 and Bayobab (MTN Group) announced a partnership in May 2023 to co-develop Project East2West, a terrestrial fibre network of up to about US$320-325 million linking landlocked countries to east and west coast subsea cables, with Zambia listed among the countries covered and Africa50 investment committee approval on 21 July 2023.

The World Bank's project information document for the Digital Zambia Acceleration Project states that cross-border infrastructure between countries is missing in Zambia, hindering seamless digital trade; the document is dated 20 January 2025 and gives no earlier date.

fact: Zambia and Mozambique commissioned the Chanida-Cassacatiza cross-border fibre interconnector, linking Zambia's national backbone to Mozambique's submarine cable network, reported on 2026-02-23.
source_slug: 2026-02-23 Zambia and Mozambique launch fibre-optic interconnector at Chanida–Cassacatiza border
